title: API email 2FA verify flow
summary: REST API now supports email 2FA end-to-end. POST /api/auth/login returns a pending challenge instead of TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED when 2FA is on; mobile completes login via POST /api/auth/2fa/verify with the emailed code. POST /api/auth/2fa/resend rotates the OTP. Adds api_2fa_challenges table (migration 056), App\ApiTwoFactorChallenge model, six new error codes, Postman + docs updates, and an E2E spec that toggles 2FA + reads the OTP from the DB.

items: login(): when enable_email_2fa is on and credentials are valid, create challenge via ApiTwoFactorChallenge::create and email the code; respond apiSuccess({ pending_2fa, challenge_id, expires_at, email_hint })
login(): when 2FA-enabled account has no email, respond TWO_FACTOR_NO_EMAIL (403)
verify2fa(): new method for POST /api/auth/2fa/verify; reads { challenge_id, code }, branches on ApiTwoFactorChallenge::verify status and issues api_tokens on VERIFY_OK
resend2fa(): new method for POST /api/auth/2fa/resend; rotates OTP and re-sends email (TWO_FACTOR_SEND_FAILED on SMTP failure)
Shared issueTokenResponse() helper used by direct login and post-verify success paths
New api_2fa_challenges table: challenge_id, user_id (FK ON DELETE CASCADE), code_hash (sha256), expires_at, attempts/max_attempts, consumed_at, ip_address, user_agent
Model methods: create, rotateCode (resend), verify (NOT_FOUND/EXPIRED/LOCKED/INVALID_CODE/ALREADY_USED/OK), consume, cleanupExpired (auto on create), maskEmail

New stable codes: TWO_FACTOR_NO_EMAIL (403), TWO_FACTOR_SEND_FAILED (502), TWO_FACTOR_INVALID_CODE (401), TWO_FACTOR_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED (410), TWO_FACTOR_CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND (404), TWO_FACTOR_LOCKED (429)
Legacy TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED message updated to mean: server cannot start 2FA for this account (kept for backwards compatibility)
Auth (REST) folder: Login now captures data.challenge_id into twofa_challenge_id; added 2FA verify and 2FA resend requests
PAPeR Local environment: new twofa_challenge_id variable
Endpoint table updated; new §3.1 (API_AUTH) and §3.4 (MOBILE) cover the challenge → verify → token flow and error code matrix
MOBILE §3.6 removed 'Email 2FA completion (no API flow)' from limitations

New stand-alone mobile-dev guide for the 2FA verify flow: sequence diagram, endpoint contracts, error matrix with UI actions, retry/resend/lockout rules, storage/security checklist, TS/Dart/Kotlin/Swift snippets, Postman + Playwright + curl smoke tests, backwards-compatibility table, server config knobs, FAQ
Linked from README.md docs map, API_AUTH.md §3.1, MOBILE_APP_INTEGRATION.md §3.4
Headless API spec: toggles enable_email_2fa via Security Settings, runs API login → reads OTP from api_2fa_challenges via cli helper → POST /api/auth/2fa/verify → assert token, then disables 2FA

tests: npm run test:e2e:api:headless; npm run test:e2e:api-2fa:headless
